title: Robert Low memo on Condon study

tellings.quote: There's a famous letter written by the deputy datan, Robert Low, who wrote a memo

plain: In 1966 or 1967, Robert Low, the second in charge of the Condon Committee, a University of Colorado study of UFOs paid for by the Air Force, wrote a memo about how the study would be run. Robert Salas, a former Air Force missile officer, brings it up as "a famous letter" and memo by Low, pointing to it as a sign that the study's outcome was shaped from the start.
